exemplars.title: Style2Fab: Functionality-Aware Segmentation for Fabricating Personalized 3D Models with Generative AI
exemplars.why: Style2Fab is the cleanest canonical exemplar: functionality-aware segmentation computes a protected set of functional geometry, while generation is restricted to the mutable aesthetic complement so personalization cannot compromise the object’s use.
exemplars.over_the_runner_up: Chosen over CICADA because its inferred semantic partition and protection of fabrication-critical geometry embody both halves of the pattern more centrally and consequentially than provenance-based preservation in a system studied primarily for perceived agency.

exemplars.title: When is a Tool a Tool? User Perceptions of System Agency in Human-AI Co-Creative Drawing
exemplars.why: CICADA provides exceptionally explicit provenance-based protection: the system treats user-authored strokes as the protected subset and applies a generation-time penalty against moving, overdrawing, or visually occluding them.
exemplars.over_the_runner_up: It outranks any further selection because no third candidate record was supplied, while its evidence directly establishes both the automatic provenance partition and generation-time enforcement required by the structural signature.

notes: I departed from the consensus by placing Style2Fab first: although CICADA has clearer mechanism evidence, Style2Fab is more central to the pattern and better demonstrates a system-inferred semantic protected region with consequential functional stakes. No score was adjusted by more than 0.3. Only two candidate records were actually provided, despite the prompt saying there were three, so a defensible third exemplar cannot be selected without inventing metadata or evidence. Readers should treat Style2Fab’s evidence cautiously: the automatic partition is inferred partly from the title, and the abstract quote does not reveal the exact enforcement mechanism. CICADA is supported by a single system-description excerpt, and the paper’s principal contribution appears to concern perceptions of agency rather than Protected Region itself.
